# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Monday, November 9, 2026

Morning edition for Monday, 9 November 2026 (IST). Covers 7–8 Nov and overnight, including Sunday's Muhurat session. Tuesday 10 Nov is a trading holiday, so this is a one-day week start.

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Update: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD allotment is due today, and Tuesday is a market holiday
Business Standard reports that Tuesday, 10 Nov is a market holiday, which is the day the 7 Nov edition carried for the BSE listing of Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs. Chittorgarh's page this morning still shows final bids of 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov and no basis-of-allotment data, and no revised listing date has been published yet.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: allotment can still take place today, but listing cannot happen on a closed exchange day, so a revised listing date is expected.
Source: [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/samvat-2083-off-to-a-tepid-start-sensex-nifty-slip-smaller-cos-up-126110800423_1.html)


### Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
| Field | Value | As of |
|---|---|---|
| Status | Closed, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026; allotment pending; 10 Nov listing date carried from the 7 Nov edition falls on a market holiday, no revised date published ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)) | 2026-11-09 |
| Size | ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe), under a ₹4,000 crore shelf; final allotment size not yet published | 2026-11-09 |
| Rating | CRISIL AA/Stable; Brickwork AA+/Stable | 2026-11-09 |
| Coupon | 8.56%–9.25% | 2026-11-09 |
| Bids | Bids stood at 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov (retail 2.51x, HNI 3.79x, NII 1.34x, institutional 0.02x) | 2026-11-05 |

### Muhurat session snaps the seven-day rally; FinNifty slips 0.38%
In Sunday's one-hour Muhurat session the Nifty 50 fell 43.95 points (0.18%) to 24,986.40 and Nifty Financial Services fell 103.30 points (0.38%) to 27,180.65, per NSE's index close file. The Sensex lost 28.62 points to 80,999.40, ending a seven-session run in which it gained 10.62%, according to PTI in BusinessLine.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the dip was small in a thin session, and the financials index goes into the NCD allotment near last week's highs; the comparison set for the proposed IPO is little changed.
Source: [NSE index closes 8 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_08112026.csv)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

### Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's microfinance subsidiary, rises 3.74% in the Muhurat session
Muthoot Microfin closed at ₹159.67 on NSE on 8 Nov, up ₹5.75 (3.74%) from ₹153.92, the best move among the listed gold-loan and Muthoot group names in the session. It traded 2,05,009 shares.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the listed subsidiary's market value is part of how the group is valued ahead of the proposed IPO, though a single Muhurat print on thin volume is a limited signal.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy 8 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_08112026.csv)

ICRA's Muthoot Fincorp page shows no rating action after the 6 Nov Delta 3.0 confirmation, and the NSE announcements feed for 7–8 Nov has nothing from Muthoot Fincorp.

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Gold-loan peers ease in the Muhurat hour; IIFL edges up
On NSE on 8 Nov, Muthoot Finance fell 0.49% to ₹2,855.00, Manappuram 0.74% to ₹323.00, Bajaj Finance 0.55% to ₹1,081.75 and Shriram Finance 0.11% to ₹960.05, while IIFL Finance rose 0.64% to ₹629.75. NSE's provisional data had FIIs net sellers of ₹0.25 crore and DIIs net sellers of ₹700.31 crore in the session.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: modest profit-taking followed last week's 12–19% gains in gold lenders; the peer valuations relevant to the proposed IPO barely moved.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy 8 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_08112026.csv)

### Spot gold steady near $4,074 in early Asian trade; Brent below $98
Reuters reported spot gold up 0.2% at $4,073.59 an ounce at 00:16 GMT on Monday, with traders putting a 79% chance on a Fed rate rise in December after Friday's payrolls. Brent fell 64 cents to $97.67 a barrel in early trade after President Trump said fresh attacks on Iran were "highly unlikely" while talks progress, Reuters reported separately.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: dollar gold is holding last week's 5% gain; AGLOC's 85% ceiling stays at ₹11,013/g until a new period is published.
Source: [Reuters via The Edge Malaysia](https://theedgemalaysia.com/node/825004)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

### No new NBFC circular from RBI, SEBI, IBBI or NHB since Friday
RBI's notifications feed still ends with the 5 Nov cyber-resilience Master Directions for payment system operators, and its press releases end with routine 6 Nov items. SEBI's newest circular is from 5 Nov, IBBI's site shows a last update of 31 Oct, and NHB's newest notice is dated 4 Nov. Details in the regulation report.
Source: [RBI notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx)

### Update: NBFCs weigh higher rates and fees to offset IRDAI's proposed insurance-commission caps
New since the 7 Nov edition, ET reports that Bajaj Housing Finance and Home First Finance are looking at higher processing fees, pricing and product-mix changes to make up lost insurance distribution income. Home First puts the pre-mitigation hit at about 35 bps of RoA, and an ICRA study cited by ET put insurance distribution income at 8% of NBFC PAT in FY26, up from 0.8% in FY23.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: lenders that earn insurance-referral fees alongside loans face the same pressure on fee income; housing lenders are the first to say they will pass it on through pricing.
Source: [Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/nbfcs-may-raise-loan-rates-fees-to-offset-insurance-income-cap/articleshow/135667186.cms)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

No significant developments today. Fusion Finance's post-results commentary is in the microfinance deep dive below.

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

### CRISIL keeps Avendus Finance on Watch Positive pending the Mizuho deal; CP limit raised to ₹300 crore
CRISIL on 6 Nov kept Avendus Finance's A+ long-term rating on Rating Watch with Positive Implications and reaffirmed A1+ on commercial paper, now enhanced to ₹300 crore from ₹200 crore. CRISIL says the rating could move up a notch or more once Mizuho Securities completes its stake purchase in parent Avendus Capital, which management expects by end-November subject to the NBFC licence approval still pending.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no direct overlap with a wholesale lender; the case shows how a strategic parent can lift an Indian NBFC's rating.
Source: [CRISIL](https://www.crisilratings.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/AvendusFinancePrivateLimited_November%2006_%202026_RR_409679.html)

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

No significant developments today. The Arka Fincap–TPG deal was covered on 8 Nov.

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

### Spandana Sphoorty starts a forensic audit of its ₹7.80 crore cyber fraud
Spandana Sphoorty told the exchanges on 7 Nov that it has hired PKF Consulting Services to run a forensic audit of the 1 Nov incident in which about ₹7.80 crore was moved out of one of its bank accounts to several beneficiary accounts without authorisation. The company says operations are running as usual and the incident has had no material impact.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a bank-account fraud at a listed microfinance lender puts payment-authorisation controls across the sector, including at Muthoot Microfin, under closer scrutiny.
Source: [NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/SPANDANA_07112026203939_SE_Intimation.pdf)

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

No significant developments today. CRIF High Mark's September microfinance delinquency data is in the deep dive below.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

No significant developments today.

## 🏭 Sector Deep Dive — Monday: Microfinance & SHG lending

### Banks pull back from microfinance as NBFC-MFIs take 44.7% of the market
CRIF High Mark data for September show the industry's gross loan portfolio down 5% YoY to ₹3.28 lakh crore, with banks' share falling to 21.8% from 31.3% as their book shrank 34%. NBFC-MFIs lifted their share to 44.7% from 38.8% and grew their book 9.4% to ₹1.47 lakh crore, while 31–90 dpd PAR held at 0.8% between June and September.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: its subsidiary Muthoot Microfin operates in the NBFC-MFI segment that is gaining share, and stable early delinquency is the backdrop for consolidated Q2 results. Average ticket size rose 17.5% to ₹63,100.
Source: [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/banks-retreat-from-microfinance-ceding-ground-to-specialist-lenders-crif-high-mark/article71669670.ece)

### Update: Fusion Finance sees demand back in October but may trim its ₹10,000 crore AUM target
New since its Q2 results (covered 4 Nov), Fusion's MD Sanjay Garyali told Business Standard that floods across 140–150 branches in five states held back disbursements, so the FY27 AUM target of about ₹10,000 crore may moderate, though growth returned in October. He guided credit costs of 2–2.5%, said incremental borrowing costs have fallen to about 9.4% from 12.5–13%, and expects NIMs up about 20 bps in Q3.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: lower funding costs and recovering demand across NBFC-MFIs are relevant to Muthoot Microfin; weather-related disruption is a sector-wide factor for Q3.
Source: [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/finance/news/fusion-finance-targets-20-25-aum-growth-as-loan-demand-picks-up-in-h2fy27-126110800384_1.html)

# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Monday, 9 November 2026 (IST)

---


## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

✅ No new RBI, SEBI, IBBI, NHB or FIU-IND instrument for NBFCs since Friday evening. Two items worth logging are below, neither of them a circular.

### Tuesday's market holiday moves Muthoot Fincorp's NCD listing off 10 Nov
Business Standard reports that Tuesday, 10 Nov is a market holiday, and that is the date the 7 Nov edition carried for the BSE listing of Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs. No revised listing date has been published on Chittorgarh this morning, and allotment data for today is not out yet.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a closed exchange day pushes the listing out by at least a day; a revised date is expected from the company or the exchange.
Reference: exchange holiday calendar (no circular) · Addressed to: market participants · Issued: 8 Nov 2026 (press report)
Source: [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/samvat-2083-off-to-a-tepid-start-sensex-nifty-slip-smaller-cos-up-126110800423_1.html)

### Watchlist sweep: nothing new for gold-loan NBFCs on 7–9 Nov
RBI's notifications feed still ends with the 5 Nov Master Directions on cyber resilience for non-bank payment system operators, and its press releases end with routine 6 Nov items. The Master Directions page carries no NBFC "updated as on" date in November, and the FAQ page's newest NBFC entry is still "All you wanted to know about NBFCs" dated 15 Sep 2026. SEBI's newest circular is from 5 Nov, IBBI's site shows a last update of 31 Oct, NHB's newest notice (4 Nov) is a broker-empanelment waiver, and FIU-IND's homepage lists no new dated notice. Outside the regulators, ET reported on 9 Nov that housing lenders plan higher fees and rates to offset IRDAI's proposed caps on credit-linked insurance commissions; the IRDAI proposal itself was covered on 7 Nov.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none from the regulators today. The open rule items remain the 21 Nov Credit Risk-o-Meter start for listed debt and the 26 Nov PSL comment window.
Source: [RBI notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx)

## Latest circulars (last 10 days)

cards.title: Update: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD allotment is due today, and Tuesday is a market holiday
cards.summary: Business Standard reports that Tuesday, 10 Nov is a market holiday, which is the day the 7 Nov edition carried for the BSE listing of Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs. Chittorgarh's page this morning still shows final bids of 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov and no basis-of-allotment data, and no revised listing date has been published yet.
cards.impact: allotment can still take place today, but listing cannot happen on a closed exchange day, so a revised listing date is expected.

cards.title: Muhurat session snaps the seven-day rally; FinNifty slips 0.38%
cards.summary: In Sunday's one-hour Muhurat session the Nifty 50 fell 43.95 points (0.18%) to 24,986.40 and Nifty Financial Services fell 103.30 points (0.38%) to 27,180.65, per NSE's index close file. The Sensex lost 28.62 points to 80,999.40, ending a seven-session run in which it gained 10.62%, according to PTI in BusinessLine.
cards.impact: the dip was small in a thin session, and the financials index goes into the NCD allotment near last week's highs; the comparison set for the proposed IPO is little changed.

cards.title: Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's microfinance subsidiary, rises 3.74% in the Muhurat session
cards.summary: Muthoot Microfin closed at ₹159.67 on NSE on 8 Nov, up ₹5.75 (3.74%) from ₹153.92, the best move among the listed gold-loan and Muthoot group names in the session. It traded 2,05,009 shares.
cards.impact: the listed subsidiary's market value is part of how the group is valued ahead of the proposed IPO, though a single Muhurat print on thin volume is a limited signal.

cards.title: Gold-loan peers ease in the Muhurat hour; IIFL edges up
cards.summary: On NSE on 8 Nov, Muthoot Finance fell 0.49% to ₹2,855.00, Manappuram 0.74% to ₹323.00, Bajaj Finance 0.55% to ₹1,081.75 and Shriram Finance 0.11% to ₹960.05, while IIFL Finance rose 0.64% to ₹629.75. NSE's provisional data had FIIs net sellers of ₹0.25 crore and DIIs net sellers of ₹700.31 crore in the session.
cards.impact: modest profit-taking followed last week's 12–19% gains in gold lenders; the peer valuations relevant to the proposed IPO barely moved.

cards.title: Spot gold steady near $4,074 in early Asian trade; Brent below $98
cards.summary: Reuters reported spot gold up 0.2% at $4,073.59 an ounce at 00:16 GMT on Monday, with traders putting a 79% chance on a Fed rate rise in December after Friday's payrolls. Brent fell 64 cents to $97.67 a barrel in early trade after President Trump said fresh attacks on Iran were "highly unlikely" while talks progress, Reuters reported separately.
cards.impact: dollar gold is holding last week's 5% gain; AGLOC's 85% ceiling stays at ₹11,013/g until a new period is published.

cards.title: Update: NBFCs weigh higher rates and fees to offset IRDAI's proposed insurance-commission caps
cards.summary: New since the 7 Nov edition, ET reports that Bajaj Housing Finance and Home First Finance are looking at higher processing fees, pricing and product-mix changes to make up lost insurance distribution income. Home First puts the pre-mitigation hit at about 35 bps of RoA, and an ICRA study cited by ET put insurance distribution income at 8% of NBFC PAT in FY26, up from 0.8% in FY23.
cards.impact: lenders that earn insurance-referral fees alongside loans face the same pressure on fee income; housing lenders are the first to say they will pass it on through pricing.

cards.title: CRISIL keeps Avendus Finance on Watch Positive pending the Mizuho deal; CP limit raised to ₹300 crore
cards.summary: CRISIL on 6 Nov kept Avendus Finance's A+ long-term rating on Rating Watch with Positive Implications and reaffirmed A1+ on commercial paper, now enhanced to ₹300 crore from ₹200 crore. CRISIL says the rating could move up a notch or more once Mizuho Securities completes its stake purchase in parent Avendus Capital, which management expects by end-November subject to the NBFC licence approval still pending.
cards.impact: no direct overlap with a wholesale lender; the case shows how a strategic parent can lift an Indian NBFC's rating.

cards.title: Spandana Sphoorty starts a forensic audit of its ₹7.80 crore cyber fraud
cards.summary: Spandana Sphoorty told the exchanges on 7 Nov that it has hired PKF Consulting Services to run a forensic audit of the 1 Nov incident in which about ₹7.80 crore was moved out of one of its bank accounts to several beneficiary accounts without authorisation. The company says operations are running as usual and the incident has had no material impact.
cards.impact: a bank-account fraud at a listed microfinance lender puts payment-authorisation controls across the sector, including at Muthoot Microfin, under closer scrutiny.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Monday: Microfinance & SHG lending
cards.title: Banks pull back from microfinance as NBFC-MFIs take 44.7% of the market
cards.summary: CRIF High Mark data for September show the industry's gross loan portfolio down 5% YoY to ₹3.28 lakh crore, with banks' share falling to 21.8% from 31.3% as their book shrank 34%. NBFC-MFIs lifted their share to 44.7% from 38.8% and grew their book 9.4% to ₹1.47 lakh crore, while 31–90 dpd PAR held at 0.8% between June and September.
cards.impact: its subsidiary Muthoot Microfin operates in the NBFC-MFI segment that is gaining share, and stable early delinquency is the backdrop for consolidated Q2 results. Average ticket size rose 17.5% to ₹63,100.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Monday: Microfinance & SHG lending
cards.title: Update: Fusion Finance sees demand back in October but may trim its ₹10,000 crore AUM target
cards.summary: New since its Q2 results (covered 4 Nov), Fusion's MD Sanjay Garyali told Business Standard that floods across 140–150 branches in five states held back disbursements, so the FY27 AUM target of about ₹10,000 crore may moderate, though growth returned in October. He guided credit costs of 2–2.5%, said incremental borrowing costs have fallen to about 9.4% from 12.5–13%, and expects NIMs up about 20 bps in Q3.
cards.impact: lower funding costs and recovering demand across NBFC-MFIs are relevant to Muthoot Microfin; weather-related disruption is a sector-wide factor for Q3.

Commencement of SEBI Settlement Regulations, 2026
latest_circulars.summary: SEBI PR No.70/2026 (6 Nov) confirms the Settlement Regulations, 2026 — notified 8 Oct 2026 — come into force on 7 Nov 2026. FAQs, an online settlement-amount calculator, an online application form and a help desk are available on sebi.gov.in.
latest_circulars.impact: not a lending or gold-loan circular. It matters for any future SEBI civil or administrative exposure on listed NCDs or related intermediary conduct.

SEBI circulars on 5 Nov: accredited investors, MF net settlement, currency-derivatives limits
latest_circulars.summary: SEBI issued three circulars on 5 Nov: HO/19/34/11(6)2026-AFD-POD1/I/25244/2026 (accredited-investor framework), HO/24/13/(1)2026-IMD-POD-2/I/25242/2026 (net settlement of funds for mutual-fund cash-market trades), and HO/(561)2026-MRD-POD2/I/25177/2026 (currency-derivatives underlying-exposure limits). None is addressed to NBFCs as lenders.
latest_circulars.impact: none for lending or NCD disclosure. Listed only so the circulars list stays complete.

latest_circulars.title: Consolidation of Instructions Related to Priority Sector Lending – Drafts for Comments
latest_circulars.summary: RBI on 5 Nov placed five draft Priority Sector Lending Directions on its website — one each for commercial banks, small finance banks, local area banks, regional rural banks and urban co-operative banks — and invited comments by 26 Nov 2026. The drafts consolidate existing PSL targets and classification rules; ETBFSI reports they retain the overall PSL targets and the 5% cap on eligible bank lending through NBFCs for on-lending.
latest_circulars.impact: no new NBFC Direction today, but the retained 5% on-lending cap is the ceiling that shapes how much PSL-eligible bank money can reach gold and other NBFC books through the on-lending channel.

latest_circulars.title: Review of Know Your Client process for individual Person Resident Outside India clients
latest_circulars.summary: SEBI's 4 Nov circular removes the effective requirement that a non-resident individual be in India to finish KYC, so intermediaries can onboard such clients digitally. Intermediaries must pass the KYC information to a KRA within 3 working days.
latest_circulars.impact: no lending impact. Non-resident investors seeking its listed NCDs through a demat account may find onboarding easier from December.

FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026
latest_circulars.summary: RBI published Notification No. FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB dated 2 Nov 2026, the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026. It amends the principal regulations of 13 Jan 2026 and is stated to come into force from 1 Oct 2026.
latest_circulars.impact: none expected, as the amendment concerns export-import transactions rather than domestic lending.
